map.14 项里哪几项最影响总分？: Which of the 14 items affect the total score most?
map.→ 打开质量（服务标准/检查/改进）工具: -> Open the quality (service standard / inspection / improvement) tool
map.人员得分 = (持证上岗率 + 培训完成率 + 着装规范率 + 出勤率) / 4: Staff score = (certification rate + training completion rate + dress compliance rate + attendance rate) / 4; service process score = (patrol coverage rate + access registration rate + response score + record completeness rate) / 4, where the response score converts from response time as <=3 min = 100, <=5 = 80, <=10 = 50, >10 = 20; equipment score = (monitoring coverage rate + equipment intact rate + communication equipment rate) / 3; satisfaction score = max(0, (satisfaction + complaint resolution rate)/2 − max(0, monthly complaints − 5) × 3); total = staff×25% + process×30% + equipment×20% + satisfaction×25%
map.保安/物业项目月度质检：录入持证率、巡逻到位率、响应时间等 14 项，得到四维度: Monthly quality inspection for security and property projects: enter the 14 items including certification rate, patrol coverage rate and response time to get four dimension scores and a total.
map.响应时间把流程分拉下来: Response time drags the process score down
map.四个维度权重合计 100%，流程权重最高是因为服务交付过程最容易被抽查取证。响应: The four dimension weights total 100%. Process carries the highest weight because the service delivery process is easiest to spot-check and evidence. Response time is a reverse indicator (lower is better) and must first be converted to a percentage score before averaging with the other ratio indicators, otherwise "lower is better" would be counted as "worse when low". Each complaint beyond 5 costs 3 points, a super-threshold penalty rather than a linear deduction, simulating the "tolerance threshold" management convention; the satisfaction score is floored at 0 so negatives cannot offset it. The total bands are >=90 excellent, >=75 good, >=60 average, <60 fail, used to rank corrective priorities.
map.填 0 等同于完全不达标，会明显拉低该维度得分；建议按实际估算填写，或本次先不纳: Entering 0 counts as completely non-compliant and clearly drags that dimension down; estimate realistically, or leave it out of the scoring this round and note it in the comments.
map.总分 90 以上还需要整改吗？: Does a total above 90 still need rectification?
map.投标或续约前自查，用总分与等级说明服务水平，并列出需整改的短板项。: Self-check before bidding or renewal, using the total and grade to show the service level and listing the weak items needing rectification.
map.按人员、执行、装备、服务四类共十四项指标评分并加权得出服务质量总分与待改进项，适: Scores and weights 14 indicators in four categories (personnel, execution, equipment, service) to produce a total service quality score and improvement items, for security services and on-site quality inspection.
map.整改后复测，对比前后总分判断措施是否真正落到关键维度。: Re-measure after rectification and compare the before and after totals to judge whether the measures really reached the key dimensions.
map.服务流程权重最高（30%），其中响应时间是唯一的非线性项（≤3 分钟 100 分: The service process carries the highest weight (30%), and within it response time is the only non-linear item (<=3 min scores 100, >10 min only 20); it is usually the item that costs the most points.
map.某项暂时取不到数，填 0 可以吗？: A value is temporarily unavailable; can I enter 0?
map.质量（服务标准/检查/改进） 使用指南: Quality (service standard / inspection / improvement) user guide
map.需要看四维度分解。任一维度明显低于其他维度（如装备 60、其余 95）仍应专项整: You need to see the four-dimension breakdown. If any dimension is clearly below the others (such as equipment at 60 while the rest are 95) it still needs dedicated rectification, because in accidents the weakest dimension is often decisive.
map.：其余三项均在 95% 以上，但事件响应时间 12 分钟（折算仅 20 分），服: : the other three items are all above 95%, but the incident response time of 12 minutes converts to only 20 points, so the service process score is about (96+94+20+92)/4≈75.5 and the total is pulled down to 82; at this point the marginal benefit of changing the response process far exceeds pushing the patrol rate higher.
map.：满意度 92%、投诉解决率 88%、月投诉 9 次：满意度得分 =(92+88: : satisfaction 92%, complaint resolution rate 88%, 9 complaints per month: satisfaction score =(92+88)/2−(9−5)×3 = 78; cutting monthly complaints to within 5 raises that item to 90 and the total by about 3 points.
